subject: 🏃 Saturday — Rest Day (Wk 8 Deload)
html:
Tomorrow is a full rest day — or a 30-min easy walk if you want to move, nothing more. This is the last recovery day before Sunday's 10-mi long run, which is the most important session of the deload week: it's your first fueling rehearsal at effort since the Presidio under-fueling exposed the binding marathon constraint. Protect Sunday by doing nothing tomorrow.

Sunday preview — 10 mi Long Run + Maurten Gel 100 rehearsal. Easy aerobic by HR (Z2, 140–150). The run itself is not hard; the point is practicing gel intake at effort. Plan: 1 Maurten Gel 100 at T−5→0, then one every ~25 min, plus Maurten Drink Mix sips — targeting 60–70 g/hr. This is the direct fix for the Presidio problem (one gel in 97 min, couldn't fuel above HR 155). Prep tonight: lay out gels, handheld bottle, and LMNT so you're not scrambling in the morning. Decide your route — hilly door route is fine since HR governs, but a gentler profile lets you focus on the fueling mechanics rather than managing climbs.

Right hamstring check-in. The twinge flagged Wednesday (Jun 24) — almost certainly HM descent residue, not a strain. If it's still talking after Thursday's 6 mi and today's gym session, do some gentle hamstring sweeps and foam rolling tonight. If it sharpened at all during the lift, let me know — we'd soften Sunday's effort accordingly.

Focus cue: fueling logistics. Spend 5 minutes tonight thinking through Sunday's gel schedule so you're not making decisions mid-run. Write the times on your hand or set watch alerts. The goal is to take each gel on schedule even if you don't feel like it — that's the whole rehearsal.

Where you are: Week 8 of 12, deload. 29 days to race day. Knee has been 1/5 every session since Presidio — the most important trend in the build. Rest up tonight. Bed by 10.
